title: Number of Home Caregiving Grant Applicants and Top Conditions Cared for by Applicants
what_it_is: Number of Home Caregiving Grant Applicants and Top Conditions Cared for by Applicants

sections.label: HCG applicant age breakdown
sections.summary: Most HCG applicants were aged 70 and above, and the Ministry of Health does not collect information on their specific conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Of which, 74% were aged 70 and above, 15% were aged 60 to 69, 5% were aged 50 to 59, 2% were aged 40 to 49, and 1% were aged 30 to 39, at the point of application.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health does not collect information on the specific conditions of HCG applicants.

sections.label: Extending HCG to mental health conditions
sections.summary: A Member asks whether HCG can be extended to care recipients with diagnosed mental health conditions, noting HCG is means-tested and for those unable to perform ADLs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: So, could I check whether the Government can extend the HCG to care recipients who are facing diagnosed mental health conditions and, if necessary, to introduce the appropriate criteria similar to ADLs for this qualification?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I would want to explain that the HCG is actually designed to help defray caregiving costs and expenses for those with greater needs and that is why it is actually means-tested.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The recipients are those who are unable to perform the ADLs.

sections.label: Autism and intellectual disability caregivers
sections.summary: Caregivers of those with autism, intellectual disability or mental health conditions satisfy HCG requirements if the care recipient cannot perform ADLs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: When the Member asked the question about the caregivers of those with autism or intellectual disability, as well as those with mental health conditions, actually, if they meet the criteria of not being able to perform the ADLs, they will satisfy the requirement of HCG.

sections.label: HCG requirements and greater needs
sections.summary: HCG has certain requirements and is intended to help those with the most or greater needs regarding ADLs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, it may not just be from the HCG.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that, at the moment, yes, HCG has certain requirements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It is meant and intended to help those with the most or greater needs with regard to ADLs.

sections.label: ADL eligibility and doctor certification
sections.summary: A care recipient permanently unable to perform daily activities, certified by a doctor, would be eligible to apply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The description of what the ADLs are, is quite clear.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, if, let us say, the care recipient is not able to perform those daily activities permanently and the doctor certifies that he or she is not able to do so, then they would be eligible to apply for this.
